      Collection<AdvancementCriterion> find(String name)

      name - The name

      The criteria

    • findFirst

      Optional<AdvancementCriterion> findFirst(String name)
      Attempts to find the first child AdvancementCriterion with the specified name. The children will be checked recursively, but direct children are prioritized.
      Parameters:
      name - The name
      Returns:
      The criterion
